questions: Should the weights be interpreted as probabilities (summing to 1) or as relative weights (any positive numbers)?
If multiple products have the same rating, how should ties be broken in the sort order?
Is the random seed applied globally (affecting other random calls) or locally only to this function's randomness?
Should the function handle duplicate product names in the input list, and if so, should they be treated as separate entries?
Are the ratings required to be numeric (for sorting descending), or could they be strings/other comparable types?
If weights list length differs from ratings list length, should the function raise an error or default to equal weights?

Is the random selection with replacement (as choices default) or without replacement across products?
